note: Cell-to-source bindings are withheld while the grid transform is PROVISIONAL. This mirrors the stance tools/spatial_aoi_fetcher already takes with UNAVAILABLE_CANONICAL_GRID_UNGEOREFERENCED: an uncertified georeference must not be used to assert which provider object covers which cell, because a wrong transform would silently bind every cell to the wrong tile. The manifestation registry and the deduplicated fetch plan are unaffected -- they resolve an area of interest in WGS84 directly against provider footprints and never need the cell grid. Populating this file is gated on TRANSFORM_CERTIFICATION_GATE.
